title: Number of Subsequences That Satisfy the Given Sum Condition
goal: Count nonempty subsequences whose minimum plus maximum does not exceed target.
strategy: After sorting, fix each possible minimum. If the current maximum fits, every subset of eligible interior positions is allowed; otherwise lower the maximum.
